answer: Time-Locked Attention Ledger. Each identity must complete a randomized sequence of micro-tasks whose jade tokens only unlock after a fixed delay, forcing sustained real-time presence. Sybils cannot parallelize the wait: each fake identity pays the full wall-clock delay plus idle capacity. Marble scores track completion consistency, and a fable hash binds each commit to its delay window. The attacker's cost is linear in identities times delay, making mass fabrication dominate any short-term gain.
